id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

sourceSystemsCache.description: A map of {@link SourceSystem#name} to cached information about the source system for quick lookup in the UI.

sourceCollectionsCache.description: A map of {@link SourceCollection#name} to cached information about the source collection for quick lookup in the UI.

loadingState.description: The loading state of different parts of the Data Sources cache.

tableSchemaCache.description: Stores a map of sourceCollectionName to its table schema information

tableSchemaCacheFetched.description: Indicates that tableSchemaCache has been fetched and stored

soureFilesCache.description: A map of {@link SourceFile} ids to {@link SelfServiceDISourceFileCacheItem}

fileUploadFirstLoadMap.description:
A map of source collection names to whether it is the first time loading this source collection
This is used in {@link RefreshFileUploadSourceCollectionStatusEpic} to determine
whether someone aborted file upload by refreshing the page.

transformCacheFetched.description: Indicates that Transform cache has been fetched and stored

filesProperties.description: A map of {@link SourceCollection#name} to cached information about the files properties for quick lookup in the UI.

title:
Application state specifically related to the Data Sources cache in the Self Service DI application. This cache is
used when rendering the tree list of data sources based on the {@link SourceSystem}s and
{@link SourceCollection}s configured for the application.
name: SelfServiceDIDataSourcesCacheApplicationState
